title.zh: 卷十六 列傳第十 王亮 張稷 王瑩
title.en: Volume 16: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying
title.raw: 卷十六 列傳第十 王亮 張稷 王瑩 Volume 16: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying

sentences.zh: 梁書卷第十六 列傳第十

translations.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 16, Biographies 10
translations.idiomatic: Book of Liang, Volume 16, Biographies 10

sentences.zh: 王亮 張稷 王瑩

translations.literal: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying
translations.idiomatic: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying

sentences.zh: 王亮字奉叔，琅邪臨沂人，晉丞相導之六世孫也。

translations.literal: Wang Liang, styled Fengshu, was a native of Linyi in Langye; he was sixth-generation descendant of Jin Chancellor Dao.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Liang, styled Fengshu, came from Linyi in Langye—a sixth-generation descendant of Jin Chancellor Dao.

sentences.zh: 祖偃，宋右光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yan was Song Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, opening the government with ritual equal to the three excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yan had been Song right grand master of splendid happiness, opening the government with ritual equal to the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 父攸，給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: His father You was Attendant Yellow Gate Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: His father You was an attendant yellow gate gentleman.

sentences.zh: 亮以名家子，宋末選尚公主，拜駙馬都尉、秘書郎，累遷桂陽王文學，南郡王友，秘書丞。

translations.literal: Liang was a scion of a famous house; at the end of Song he was chosen to marry a princess, made Commandant of the Horse for the Imperial Son-in-law and Secretary Gentleman, and rose through Literary Scholar to the Prince of Guiyang, Friend to the Prince of Nankang, and Secretary Assistant.
translations.idiomatic: As a son of a great house, at the end of Song he was matched to a princess, made commandant of the horse for the imperial son-in-law and secretary gentleman, and rose through literary scholar to the prince of Guiyang, friend to the prince of Nankang, and secretary assistant.

sentences.zh: 齊竟陵王子良開西邸，延才俊以爲士林館，使工圖畫其像，亮亦預焉。

translations.literal: Qi Prince of Jingling Zi Liang opened the Western Lodge, gathering talented men for the Scholars' Grove Hall and having artisans paint their portraits—Liang was among them.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi's prince of Jingling opened the Western Lodge and gathered worthies for the Scholars' Grove Hall, artisans painted their likenesses—and Liang was among them.

sentences.zh: 遷中書侍郎、大司馬從事中郎，出爲衡陽太守。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Secretariat Gentleman and Chief Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal, and went out as Governor of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to secretariat gentleman and chief staff officer to the grand marshal, then went out as Hengyang governor.

sentences.zh: 以南土卑濕，辭不之官，遷給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: Because the southern land was low and humid, he declined the office and was transferred to Attendant Yellow Gate Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: The south was low and damp; he declined the post and was made attendant yellow gate gentleman.

sentences.zh: 尋拜晉陵太守，在職清公有美政。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of Jinling; in office he was pure and public-spirited, with fine governance.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Jinling governor—pure in office, with a reputation for good rule.

sentences.zh: 時齊明帝作相，聞而嘉之，引爲領軍長史，甚見賞納。

translations.literal: At the time Qi Emperor Ming was acting as regent; hearing of this he praised him, brought him in as Chief Staff Officer to the Guard General, and greatly favored and received him.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Emperor Ming was then regent; hearing of him he praised him, made him chief of staff to the guard general, and favored him deeply.

sentences.zh: 及卽位，累遷太子中庶子，尚書吏部郎，詮序著稱，遷侍中。

translations.literal: When Ming took the throne, he rose through offices to Crown Prince Palace Attendant and Director of the Ministry of Personnel—his evaluations won renown—and was promoted to Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming took the throne, Liang rose to crown prince palace attendant and director of the ministry of personnel—his rankings won fame—and then to attendant.

sentences.zh: 建武末，爲吏部尚書，是時尚書右僕射江祏管朝政，多所進拔，爲士子所歸。

translations.literal: At the end of Jianwu he was Director of the Ministry of Personnel; at the time Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Shi managed court politics, promoted many men, and was where scholars gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Jianwu he headed the ministry of personnel; Right Vice Director Jiang Shi then ran court politics, advanced many men, and drew the gentry to him.

sentences.zh: 亮自以身居選部，每持異議。

translations.literal: Liang, considering himself head of the selection bureau, often held opposing views.
translations.idiomatic: Liang, as head of selection, often took the other side.

sentences.zh: 始亮未爲吏部郎時，以祏帝之內弟，故深友祏，祏爲之延譽，益爲帝所器重；

translations.literal: At first, before Liang was Director of the Ministry of Personnel, because Shi was the emperor's brother-in-law he befriended him deeply; Shi spread his reputation, so the emperor valued him all the more;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, before Liang headed personnel, he had been close to Shi—the emperor's brother-in-law—and Shi had praised him, so the throne prized him all the more;

sentences.zh: 至是與祏昵之如初。

translations.literal: but now they were as intimate as before.
translations.idiomatic: yet now they were intimate as ever.

sentences.zh: 及祏遇誅，羣小放命，凡所除拜，悉由內寵，亮更弗能止。

translations.literal: When Shi was executed, petty men ran wild—all appointments passed through inner favorites, and Liang could no longer stop them.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi was killed, petty men had their way; every appointment ran through inner favorites, and Liang could not stop it.

sentences.zh: 外若詳審，內無明鑒，其所選用，拘資次而已，當世不謂爲能。

translations.literal: Outwardly he seemed careful in review, inwardly he lacked clear judgment; those he selected were bound by seniority alone—the age did not call him capable.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly he seemed careful; inwardly he had no clear eye. He chose by seniority alone, and the age did not call him able.

sentences.zh: 頻加通直散騎常侍、太子右衛率，爲尚書右僕射、中護軍。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly made Regular Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Right Guard Lieutenant to the Crown Prince, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly made regular attendant cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, right guard lieutenant to the crown prince, right vice director of the masters of writing, and central army commander.

sentences.zh: 旣而東昏肆虐，淫刑已逞，亮傾側取容，竟以免戮。

translations.literal: Then Eastern Depravity ran rampant and cruel punishments had their day—Liang leaned this way and that to please and escaped death by a hair.
translations.idiomatic: Then Eastern Depravity raged and cruel punishments ran their course—Liang bent to please and barely escaped death.

sentences.zh: 義師至新林，內外百僚皆道迎，其未能拔者，亦間路送誠款，亮獨不遣。

translations.literal: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, officials inside and outside all went out to welcome them; those who could not break away still sent pledges of loyalty by side roads—only Liang sent no one.
translations.idiomatic: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, officials within and without went out to welcome them; those who could not leave still sent loyalty by back roads—only Liang sent no one.

sentences.zh: 及城內旣定，獨推亮爲首。

translations.literal: When the city was settled, he alone was singled out as ringleader.
translations.idiomatic: Once the city was settled, he alone was pushed forward as ringleader.

sentences.zh: 亮出見高祖，高祖曰：「顛而不扶，安用彼相。

translations.literal: Liang came out to see Gaozu; Gaozu said: "When the toppling man is not supported, what use is that minister!
translations.idiomatic: Liang came out to see Gaozu. Gaozu said, "When the tottering man is not held up, what use is that minister!

sentences.zh: 」而弗之罪也。

translations.literal: " Yet he did not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: " Yet he did not punish him.

sentences.zh: 霸府開，以爲大司馬長史、撫軍將軍、琅邪、清河二郡太守。

translations.literal: When the Supreme Office opened, he was made Chief Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal, Pacifying Army General, and Governor of both Langye and Qinghe commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: When the supreme office opened, he was made chief of staff to the grand marshal, pacifying army general, and governor of Langye and Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 梁臺建，授侍中、尚書令，固讓不拜，乃爲侍中、中書監，兼尚書令。

translations.literal: When the Liang regime was established, he was appointed Attendant and Director of the Masters of Writing; he firmly refused; he was then made Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, and concurrently Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: When the Liang regime was set up, he was offered attendant and director of the masters of writing; he refused firmly and was made attendant, director of the secretariat, with the masters of writing added.

sentences.zh: 高祖受禪，遷侍中、尚書令、中軍將軍，引參佐命，封豫寧縣公，邑二千戶。

translations.literal: When Gaozu received the abdication, he was promoted to Attendant, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army General, drawn into assisting the mandate, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yuning with two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the mandate, Liang became attendant, director of the masters of writing, and central army general, drawn into founding the state, and was enfeoffed duke of Yuning with two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 天監二年，轉左光祿大夫，侍中、中軍如故。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianjian he was transferred to Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Attendant and Central Army unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjian's second year he was transferred to left grand master of splendid happiness; attendant and central army were unchanged.

sentences.zh: 元日朝會萬國，亮辭疾不登殿，設饌別省，而語笑自若。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day the myriad states assembled in court; Liang pleaded illness and did not ascend the hall, set out food in a separate office, yet talked and laughed as if at ease.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day the myriad states met in court; Liang pleaded illness, did not mount the hall, dined in a side office, and talked and laughed as if at ease.

sentences.zh: 數日，詔公卿問訊，亮無疾色，御史中丞樂藹奏大不敬，論棄市刑。

translations.literal: Several days later an edict had the dukes and ministers inquire; Liang showed no sign of illness; Censor-in-Chief Yue Ai memorialized for gross disrespect, penalty of execution in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Days later an edict sent dukes and ministers to inquire; Liang showed no sickness; censor-in-chief Yue Ai memorialized gross disrespect and asked the death penalty in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 詔削爵廢爲庶人。

translations.literal: An edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，高祖讌於華光殿，謂羣臣曰：「朕日昃聽政，思聞得失。

translations.literal: In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Hualin Hall and said to the assembled ministers: "From noon I hear affairs of state, wishing to learn gain and loss.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Hualin Hall and told the ministers, "From noon I hear government, wishing to learn gain and loss.

sentences.zh: 卿等可謂多士，宜各盡獻替。

translations.literal: You may be called many scholars—each should fully offer candid counsel."
translations.idiomatic: You are many scholars—each should offer full and frank counsel."

sentences.zh: 」尚書左丞范縝起曰：「司徒謝朏本有虛名，陛下擢之如此，前尚書令王亮頗有治實，陛下棄之如彼，是愚臣所不知。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Fan Zhen rose and said: "Grand Marshal Xie Tiao originally had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him thus; former Director Wang Liang truly had governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off like that—this a dull minister cannot understand."
translations.idiomatic: Left assistant director Fan Zhen rose and said, "Grand marshal Xie Tiao had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him so; former director Wang Liang had real governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off so—this dull minister cannot understand."

sentences.zh: 」高祖變色曰：「卿可更餘言。

translations.literal: Gaozu's face changed: "You may speak on other matters."
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu's color changed. "You may speak on other matters."

sentences.zh: 」縝固執不已，高祖不悅。

translations.literal: Zhen persisted without end; Gaozu was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen pressed on; Gaozu was displeased.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞任昉因奏曰：

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Ren Fang then memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Ren Fang then memorialized:

sentences.zh: 臣聞息夫歷詆，漢有正刑；

translations.literal: Your servant has heard: Xi Fu's successive slander—Han had right punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard that Xi Fu's successive slander drew right punishment in Han;

sentences.zh: 白褒一奏，晉以明罰。

translations.literal: Bai Bao's one memorial—Jin applied clear penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Bao's single memorial drew clear penalty in Jin.

sentences.zh: 況乎附下訕上，毀譽自口者哉。

translations.literal: How much more for those who fawn on inferiors and slander superiors, whose praise and blame issue from their own mouths?
translations.idiomatic: How much more those who fawn below and slander above, who praise and blame from their own mouths?

sentences.zh: 風聞尚書左丞臣范縝，自晉安還，語人云：「我不詣餘人，惟詣王亮；

translations.literal: I have heard that Left Assistant Director Fan Zhen, returning from Jin'an, told people: "I do not visit others, only Wang Liang;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that left assistant director Fan Zhen, returning from Jin'an, said, "I visit no one but Wang Liang;

sentences.zh: 不餉餘人，惟餉王亮。

translations.literal: I do not give gifts to others, only Wang Liang."
translations.idiomatic: I give gifts to no one but Wang Liang."

sentences.zh: 」輒收縝白從左右萬休到臺辨問，與風聞符同。

translations.literal: I at once arrested Zhen and had his attendant Wan Xiu brought to the bureau for questioning; it matched what was heard.
translations.idiomatic: I at once arrested Zhen and had his attendant Wan Xiu questioned at the bureau; it matched the report.

sentences.zh: 又今月十日，御餞梁州刺史臣珍國，宴私旣洽，羣臣並已謁退，時詔留侍中臣昂等十人，訪以政道。

translations.literal: Also on the tenth of this month, at a private feast for Sent-officer to Liang Province Zhen Guo, when the feast was done and the ministers had all withdrawn to pay respects, an edict retained Attendant-in-Ordinary Ang and ten others to inquire into the way of government.
translations.idiomatic: Also on the tenth of this month, at the private feast for the sent-officer to Liang province Zhen Guo, when the feast ended and the ministers had withdrawn to pay respects, an edict kept attendant-in-ordinary Ang and ten others to inquire into government.

sentences.zh: 縝不答所問，而橫議沸騰，遂貶裁司徒臣朏，褒舉庶人王亮。

translations.literal: Zhen did not answer what was asked but launched a torrent of reckless talk, disparaging Grand Marshal Tiao and praising the commoner Wang Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen did not answer what was asked but poured out reckless talk, disparaging grand marshal Tiao and praising the commoner Wang Liang.

sentences.zh: 臣于時預奉恩留，肩隨並立，耳目所接，差非風聞。

translations.literal: Your servant at the time was among those retained by grace, shoulder to shoulder standing—what eyes and ears received differs little from hearsay.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant was then among those kept by grace, standing shoulder to shoulder—what eyes and ears took in was scarcely hearsay.

sentences.zh: 竊尋王有遊豫，親御軒陛，義深推轂，情均《湛露》。

translations.literal: I reflect that when the king has outings and pleasures, he personally mounts the steps; the meaning is deep in pushing the cart, the feeling equal to "Dew on the Fronds."
translations.idiomatic: I reflect that when the king takes his pleasure, he mounts the steps in person—the meaning is deep in pushing the cart-wheel, the feeling equal to "Dew on the Fronds."

sentences.zh: 酒闌宴罷，當扆正立，記事在前，記言在後，軫早朝之念，深求瘼之情，而縝言不遜，妄陳褒貶，傷濟濟之風，缺側席之望。

translations.literal: When the wine was spent and the feast ended, he should stand upright before the screen—records before, words after—brooding on the dawn audience's cares, deeply seeking the people's afflictions—yet Zhen's words were insolent, rashly offering praise and blame, harming the orderly wind and lacking the hope of the vacant seat.
translations.idiomatic: When wine ended and the feast broke up, he should stand straight before the screen—records before, words after—mindful of the dawn audience, seeking the people's ills—yet Zhen spoke insolently and rashly praised and blamed, harming orderly custom and the hope of the vacant seat.

sentences.zh: 不有嚴裁，憲準將頹，縝卽主。

translations.literal: Without severe punishment, law's standard will collapse—Zhen is chief among this.
translations.idiomatic: Without severe punishment the law's standard will fall—and Zhen is chief among the guilty.

sentences.zh: 臣謹案：尚書左丞臣范縝，衣冠緒餘，言行舛駁，誇諧里落，喧詬周行。

translations.literal: Your servant respectfully finds: Left Assistant Director Fan Zhen, coat and cap from a fine line, conduct and words at odds, boasting in his village, clamor in the thoroughfares.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant respectfully finds that left assistant director Fan Zhen, of coat-and-cap lineage, is at odds in word and deed, boasts in his village, and clamors in the streets.

sentences.zh: 曲學諛聞，未知去代；

translations.literal: Curved learning and flattery—he does not know how to leave the age;
translations.idiomatic: Curved learning and flattery—he does not know how to leave the age;

sentences.zh: 弄口鳴舌，祇足飾非。

translations.literal: wagging tongue and clucking mouth—only enough to deck out error.
translations.idiomatic: wagging tongue and clucking mouth—only enough to dress up error.

sentences.zh: 乃者，義師近次，縝丁罹艱棘，曾不呼門，墨縗景附，頗同先覺，實奉龍顏。

translations.literal: When lately the Righteous Army was near, Zhen suffered family calamity; he never called at the gate, but in black hemp and mourning white shadowed the scene, quite like foreknowledge—truly serving the dragon countenance.
translations.idiomatic: When lately the Righteous Army drew near, Zhen suffered family calamity; he never called at the gate but in black hemp and mourning white shadowed the scene like foreknowledge—truly serving the dragon countenance.

sentences.zh: 而今黨協釁餘，飜爲矛楯，人而無恒，成茲姦詖。

translations.literal: Now he has joined with the remnants of sedition and turned enemy—man without constancy, accomplishing this treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Now he joins with the remnants of sedition and turns enemy—a man without constancy, accomplishing this treachery.

sentences.zh: 日者，飲至策勳，功微賞厚，出守名邦，入司管轄，苞篚罔遺，而假稱折轅，衣裙所弊，讒激失所，許與疵廢，廷辱民宗。

translations.literal: The day when the feast of merit was held, merit slight yet reward thick—out as governor of a famous commandery, in as overseer of a department—gift baskets not forgotten, yet he falsely claimed broken axle; dress in rags, slander stirred out of place, promises and faults discarded, court insult to a noble clan.
translations.idiomatic: At the feast of merit, merit was slight yet reward thick—out as governor of a famous commandery, in as overseer of a department—gift baskets not forgotten, yet he falsely claimed a broken axle; in rags he stirred slander, discarded promises and faults, and insulted a noble clan in court.

sentences.zh: 自居樞憲，糾奏寂寞。

translations.literal: Since taking the pivot of censorate, memorials of impeachment have been silent.
translations.idiomatic: Since he took the pivot of the censorate, impeachments have been silent.

sentences.zh: 顧望縱容，無至公之議；

translations.literal: Looking about and indulging, no debate of utmost public right;
translations.idiomatic: He looks about and indulges, with no debate of utmost public right;

sentences.zh: 惡直醜正，有私訐之談。

translations.literal: hating the straight and uglifying the correct, having private impeachment talk.
translations.idiomatic: he hates the straight and uglifies the correct, and has private impeachment talk.

sentences.zh: 宜置之徽纆，肅正國典。

translations.literal: He should be placed in fetters to rectify the national statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He should be placed in fetters to rectify the national statutes.

sentences.zh: 臣等參議，請以見事免縝所居官，輒勒外收付廷尉法獄治罪。

translations.literal: Your servant and others jointly recommend: remove Zhen from his present office on the facts before us, and at once command the outer offices to take him and deliver to the law prison of the Court of Justice for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant and others jointly recommend that Zhen be removed from his present office on the facts before us, and that the outer offices at once take him and deliver him to the Court of Justice law prison for punishment.

sentences.zh: 應諸連逮，委之獄官，以法制從事。

translations.literal: All who should be implicated and seized, entrust to the prison officers to proceed by statute.
translations.idiomatic: All who should be implicated and seized, entrust to the prison officers to proceed by statute.

sentences.zh: 縝位應黃紙，臣輒奉白簡。

translations.literal: Zhen's post requires yellow paper—your servant hastens to present white bamboo slips.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen's post requires yellow paper—your servant hastens to present white bamboo slips.

sentences.zh: 詔聞可。

translations.literal: Edict: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: Approved.

sentences.zh: 璽書詰縝曰：「亮少乏才能，無聞時輩，昔經冒入羣英，相與豈薄，晚節諂事江祏，爲吏部，末協附梅蟲兒、茹法珍，遂執昏政。

translations.literal: An imperial letter reprimanded Zhen: "Liang in youth lacked talent and was unknown among contemporaries; formerly he rashly entered the ranks of worthies—we with one another were not thin; in his later years he flattered Jiang Shi; as Director of Personnel he finally joined with Mei Chong'er and Ru Fazhen and so held benighted government.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial letter reprimanded Zhen: "Liang in youth lacked talent and was unknown among his peers; formerly he rashly entered the ranks of worthies—we were not thin with one another; in his later years he flattered Jiang Shi; as director of personnel he finally joined Mei Chong'er and Ru Fazhen and held benighted government.

sentences.zh: 比屋罹禍，盡家塗炭，四海沸騰，天下橫潰，此誰之咎！

translations.literal: Household upon household met disaster, whole families were scorched; the four seas seethed, the realm collapsed—whose fault is this!
translations.idiomatic: Household upon household met disaster, whole families were scorched; the four seas seethed, the realm collapsed—whose fault is this!

sentences.zh: 食亂君之祿，不死於治世。

translations.literal: He ate the salary of a chaotic lord yet did not die in an age of order.
translations.idiomatic: He ate the salary of a chaotic lord yet did not die in an age of order.

sentences.zh: 亮協固凶黨，作威作福，靡衣玉食，女樂盈房，勢危事逼，自相吞噬。

translations.literal: Liang solidified with the vicious faction, made might and made blessing, fine clothes and jade food, female musicians filling the rooms; when peril pressed and business forced, they devoured one another.
translations.idiomatic: Liang joined the vicious faction, made might and made blessing, fine clothes and jade food, female musicians filling the rooms; when peril pressed and business forced, they devoured one another.

sentences.zh: 建石首題，啓靡請罪。

translations.literal: At Jianshi he put his head on the first draft, opened up, and asked only for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: At Jianshi he put his head on the first draft, opened up, and asked only for punishment.

sentences.zh: 朕錄其白旗之來，貰其旣往之咎。

translations.literal: I recorded his coming under the white flag and pardoned his past fault.
translations.idiomatic: I recorded his coming under the white flag and pardoned his past fault.

sentences.zh: 亮反覆不忠，姦賄彰暴，有何可論！

translations.literal: Liang was faithless and shifting, corruption and bribes openly violent—what is there to discuss!
translations.idiomatic: Liang was faithless and shifting, corruption and bribes openly violent—what is there to discuss!

sentences.zh: 妄相談述，具以狀對。

translations.literal: Rashly to talk and narrate such—fully report by memorial for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Rashly to talk and narrate such—report fully in a memorial for judgment.

sentences.zh: 」所詰十條，縝答支離而已。

translations.literal: " The ten points of censure—Zhen's answers were disjointed only.
translations.idiomatic: " The ten points of censure—Zhen's answers were disjointed only.

sentences.zh: 亮因屏居閉掃，不通賓客。

translations.literal: Liang then lived in seclusion, swept his quarters, and received no guests.
translations.idiomatic: Liang then lived in seclusion, swept his quarters, and received no guests.

sentences.zh: 遭母憂，居喪盡禮。

translations.literal: When his mother died he observed mourning in full ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he observed mourning in full ritual.

sentences.zh: 八年，詔起爲秘書監，俄加通直散騎常侍，數日遷太常卿。

translations.literal: In the eighth year an edict recalled him as Director of the Secretariat; soon he was further made Regular Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, and within days was promoted to Minister of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year an edict recalled him as director of the secretariat; soon he was further made regular attendant cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, and within days rose to minister of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 九年，轉中書監，加散騎常侍。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat with additional Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to director of the secretariat with additional cavalier attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 其年卒。

translations.literal: That year he died.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died.

sentences.zh: 詔賻錢三萬，布五十匹。

translations.literal: An edict granted thirty thousand cash and fifty bolts of cloth for funeral expenses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted thirty thousand cash and fifty bolts of cloth for funeral expenses.

sentences.zh: 諡曰煬子。

translations.literal: Posthumous title: Son Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous title: Son Yang.

sentences.zh: 張稷字公喬，吳郡人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a native of Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a man of Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 父永，宋右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: His father Yong was Song Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yong was Song right grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 稷所生母遘疾歷時，稷始年十一，夜不解衣而養，永異之。

translations.literal: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he did not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he would not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.

sentences.zh: 及母亡，毀瘠過人，杖而後起。

translations.literal: When his mother died his grief-wasting exceeded others; he rose only with a staff's support.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died his grief-wasting exceeded others; he rose only with a staff's support.

sentences.zh: 性疏率，朗悟有才略，與族兄充、融、卷等俱知名，時稱之曰：「充融卷稷，是爲四張。

translations.literal: By nature he was careless and open, bright and perceptive with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them: "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was careless and open, bright with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them, "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."

sentences.zh: 」起家著作佐郎，不拜，頻居父母憂，六載廬于墓側。

translations.literal: He began office as Editorial Assistant in the Masters of Writing but did not accept; he repeatedly sat parents' mourning, six years dwelling by the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: He began as editorial assistant in the masters of writing but did not accept; he repeatedly sat parents' mourning, six years dwelling by the tomb.

sentences.zh: 服除，爲驃騎法曹行參軍，遷外兵參軍。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was Rapid Cavalry Law Bureau Acting Staff Officer, promoted to Outer Army Staff Officer.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was rapid-cavalry law bureau acting staff officer, then outer army staff officer.

sentences.zh: 齊永明中，爲剡縣令，略不視事，多爲山水遊。

translations.literal: In Qi's Yongming era he was Governor of Shan County, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.
translations.idiomatic: In Qi's Yongming era he was Shan county magistrate, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.

sentences.zh: 會賊唐㝢之作亂，稷率厲縣人，保全縣境。

translations.literal: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.

sentences.zh: 入爲太子洗馬，大司馬東曹掾，建安王友，大司馬從事中郎。

translations.literal: He entered office as Crown Prince Purifier, Eastern Bureau Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal, Friend to the Prince of Jian'an, and Chief Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: He entered as crown prince purifier, eastern bureau staff officer to the grand marshal, friend to the prince of Jian'an, and chief staff officer to the grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 武陵王曅爲護軍，轉護軍司馬，尋爲本州治中。

translations.literal: When Prince of Wuling Ye was Guard General, Ji was transferred to Guard General Staff Officer, soon made Chief Administrator of his native province.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince of Wuling was guard general, Ji was transferred to guard general staff officer, soon made chief administrator of his native province.

sentences.zh: 明帝領牧，仍爲別駕。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as Vice Governor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as vice governor.

sentences.zh: 時魏寇壽春，以稷爲寧朔將軍、軍主，副尚書僕射沈文季鎮豫州。

translations.literal: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made Pacifying the North General and army commander, assisting Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made pacifying-the-north general and army commander, assisting right vice director Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 魏衆稱百萬，圍城累日，時經略處分，文季悉委稷焉。

translations.literal: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.

sentences.zh: 軍退，遷平西司馬、寧朔將軍、南平內史。

translations.literal: When the army withdrew, he was promoted to Pacifying the West Staff Officer, Pacifying the North General, and Interior Governor of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: When the army withdrew, he was promoted to pacifying-the-west staff officer, pacifying-the-north general, and Nanping interior governor.

sentences.zh: 魏又寇雍州，詔以本號都督荊、雍諸軍事。

translations.literal: Wei again raided Yong Province; an edict made him with his present title Commander of military affairs in Jing and Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Wei again raided Yong province; an edict made him with his present title commander of military affairs in Jing and Yong.

sentences.zh: 時雍州刺史曹虎度樊城岸，以稷知州事。

translations.literal: At the time Yong Governor Cao Hu crossed the Fan city shore; Ji was made to know provincial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yong governor Cao Hu crossed the Fan city shore; Ji was made to know provincial affairs.

sentences.zh: 魏師退，稷還荊州，就拜黃門侍郎，復爲司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守。

translations.literal: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing Province and was at once appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman, again made Staff Officer and Governor of both Xinxing and Yongning commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing province and was at once appointed yellow gate gentleman, again made staff officer and governor of Xinxing and Yongning.

sentences.zh: 郡犯私諱，改永寧爲長寧。

translations.literal: The commandery violated a private taboo, so Yongning was changed to Changning.
translations.idiomatic: The commandery violated a private taboo, so Yongning was changed to Changning.

sentences.zh: 尋遷司徒司馬，加輔國將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Grand Marshal Staff Officer with additional Assistant State General.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to grand marshal staff officer with additional assistant state general.

sentences.zh: 及江州刺史陳顯達舉兵反，以本號鎮歷陽、南譙二郡太守，遷鎮南長史、尋陽太守、輔國將軍、行江州事。

translations.literal: When Jiangzhou Inspector Chen Xianda raised troops in rebellion, with his present title he was made Governor of both Liyang and Nanqiao commanderies, promoted to Pacifying the South Chief Staff Officer, Xunyang Governor, Assistant State General, and Acting Jiangzhou Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangzhou inspector Chen Xianda raised troops in rebellion, with his present title he was made governor of Liyang and Nanqiao, promoted to pacifying-the-south chief staff officer, Xunyang governor, assistant state general, and acting Jiangzhou affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋徵還，爲持節、輔國將軍、都督北徐州諸軍事、北徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was recalled and made Bearer of Credentials, General Who Assists the State, Area Commander of all North Xuzhou military affairs, and North Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Soon recalled, he became bearer of credentials, General Who Assists the State, area commander of North Xuzhou, and North Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 出次白下，仍遷都督南兗州諸軍事、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: He posted at Baixia, then was transferred to Area Commander of all South Yanzhou military affairs and South Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: He posted at Baixia, then became area commander of South Yanzhou and South Yanzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 俄進督北徐、徐、兗、青、冀五州諸軍事，將軍並如故。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to command military affairs in North Xu, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji—five provinces in all—while his general ranks remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was advanced to command the five provinces North Xu, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji, with his general ranks unchanged.

sentences.zh: 永元末，徵爲侍中，宿衛宮城。

translations.literal: At the end of the Yongyuan era he was summoned as Attendant Within and guarded the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Yongyuan he was summoned as attendant within and guarded the palace city.

sentences.zh: 義師至，兼衛尉江淹出奔。

translations.literal: When the Righteous Army arrived, Concurrent Commandant of the Guard Jiang Yan fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous army came, Concurrent Commandant of the Guard Jiang Yan fled.

sentences.zh: 稷兼衛尉，副王瑩都督城內諸軍事。

translations.literal: Ji held the concurrent commandantship and assisted Wang Ying in commanding all military affairs within the city.
translations.idiomatic: Ji held the concurrent guard commandancy and assisted Wang Ying in commanding the city's forces.

sentences.zh: 時東昏淫虐，義師圍城已久，城內思亡而莫有先發。

translations.literal: Donghun was then depraved and cruel; the Righteous Army had besieged the city for a long time, and within the walls all wished to rebel, yet none dared act first.
translations.idiomatic: Donghun was depraved and cruel; the righteous army had long besieged the city, and everyone inside wished to turn, yet none dared move first.

sentences.zh: 北徐州刺史王珍國就稷謀之，乃使直閤張齊害東昏于含德殿。

translations.literal: North Xuzhou Inspector Wang Zhenguo consulted with Ji; Ji then had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.
translations.idiomatic: North Xuzhou inspector Wang Zhenguo plotted with Ji; Ji had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.

sentences.zh: 稷召尚書右僕射王亮等列坐殿前西鐘下，謂曰：「昔桀有昏德，鼎遷于殷；

translations.literal: Ji summoned Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang and others to sit in a row before the western bell in the hall and said: "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;
translations.idiomatic: Ji summoned Right Vice Director Wang Liang and others to sit before the western bell in the hall and said, "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;

sentences.zh: 商紂暴虐，鼎遷于周。

translations.literal: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 今獨夫自絕于天，四海已歸聖主，斯實微子去殷之時，項伯歸漢之日，可不勉哉！

translations.literal: Now the lone man has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is truly the time of Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"
translations.idiomatic: Now the tyrant has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"

sentences.zh: 」乃遣國子博士范雲、舍人裴長穆等使石頭城詣高祖，高祖以稷爲侍中、左衛將軍。

translations.literal: Then he sent National University Erudite Fan Yun, Attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to present themselves to Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji Attendant Within and Left Palace Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Then he sent National University erudite Fan Yun, attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to see Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji attendant within and left palace guard general.

sentences.zh: 高祖總百揆，遷大司馬左司馬。

translations.literal: When Gaozu oversaw all state affairs, Ji was transferred to Left Staff Officer of the Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took charge of all affairs, Ji became the grand marshal's left staff officer.

sentences.zh: 梁臺建，爲散騎常侍、中書令。

translations.literal: When the Liang regime was established he was made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When the Liang court was set up he became cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 高祖受禪，以功封江安縣侯，邑一千戶。

translations.literal: When Gaozu accepted the abdication, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for his merit, with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for merit, with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 又爲侍中、國子祭酒，領驍騎將軍，遷護軍將軍、揚州大中正，以事免。

translations.literal: He was again made Attendant Within and Chancellor of the National University, with concurrent Rapid Cavalry General; he was transferred to Protector General and Yangzhou Chief Rectifier, then dismissed over an affair.
translations.idiomatic: He again became attendant within and chancellor of the National University, with concurrent rapid cavalry general; he became protector general and Yangzhou chief rectifier, then was dismissed over an affair.

sentences.zh: 尋爲度支尚書、前將軍、太子右衛率，又以公事免。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Minister of Revenue, Front General, and Right Crown Prince Palace Guard Commander, then again dismissed over an official matter.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became minister of revenue, front general, and right crown prince palace guard commander, then was again dismissed over official business.

sentences.zh: 俄爲祠部尚書，轉散騎常侍、都官尚書、揚州大中正，以本職知領軍事。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Minister of Sacrificial Affairs, then transferred to Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Director of Capital Crimes, and Yangzhou Chief Rectifier, with this office concurrently in charge of guard-army affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became minister of sacrificial affairs, then cavalier attendant, director of capital crimes, and Yangzhou chief rectifier, concurrently commanding guard-army affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋遷領軍將軍，中正、侯如故。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Guard Army General, his chief rectifier title and marquisate remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became guard army general, keeping his chief rectifier title and marquisate.

sentences.zh: 時魏寇青州，詔假節、行州事。

translations.literal: At that time Wei invaded Qingzhou; an edict granted him temporary credentials and acting charge of the province.
translations.idiomatic: Wei then invaded Qingzhou; he was ordered to hold temporary credentials and act for the province.

sentences.zh: 會魏軍退，仍出爲散騎常侍、將軍，吳興太守，秩中二千石。

translations.literal: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General, Wuxing Administrator, with salary rank at two thousand dan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as cavalier attendant and general, Wuxing administrator, at salary rank two thousand dan.

sentences.zh: 下車存問遺老，引其子孫，置之右職，政稱寬恕。

translations.literal: On taking office he inquired after the old residents left behind and promoted their sons and grandsons to right offices; his governance was called lenient and forgiving.
translations.idiomatic: On taking office he sought out old residents and set their sons and grandsons in right offices; his rule was called lenient and forgiving.

sentences.zh: 進號雲麾將軍，徵尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: His title was advanced to Cloud-Banner General and he was summoned as Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Cloud-Banner General and summoned as left vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 輿駕將欲如稷宅，以盛暑，留幸僕射省，舊臨幸供具皆酬太官饌直，帝以稷清貧，手詔不受。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage was about to visit Ji's house; because of the intense heat the Emperor stayed instead at the Vice Director's office. By old custom items for an imperial visit were reimbursed from the Grand Provisioner's feast allowance; because Ji was pure and poor, the Emperor hand-edicted that he should not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was about to visit Ji's house; in the intense heat he stayed at the vice director's office instead. Old custom reimbursed visit supplies from the Grand Provisioner; because Ji was poor, the emperor hand-edicted that he accept nothing.

sentences.zh: 出爲使持節、散騎常侍、都督青、冀二州諸軍事、安北將軍、青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: He went out as Bearer of Credentials, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Area Commander of Qing and Ji military affairs, Pacification North General, and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as bearer of credentials, cavalier attendant, area commander of Qing and Ji, Pacification North general, and inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 會魏寇朐山，詔稷權頓六里，都督衆軍。

translations.literal: When Wei invaded Qushan, an edict ordered Ji to station temporarily at Liuli and command all armies.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei invaded Qushan, Ji was ordered to hold Liuli temporarily and command all armies.

sentences.zh: 還，進號鎮北將軍。

translations.literal: On his return his title was advanced to Garrison North General.
translations.idiomatic: On return his title was advanced to Garrison North general.

sentences.zh: 初鬱洲接邊陲，民俗多與魏人交市。

translations.literal: Earlier Yuzhou bordered the frontier, and local custom often led people to trade with Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yuzhou lay on the frontier, and its people often traded with Wei.

sentences.zh: 及朐山叛，或與魏通，旣不自安矣；

translations.literal: When Qushan rebelled, some connected with Wei; they were already uneasy;
translations.idiomatic: When Qushan rebelled, some made contact with Wei; they were already uneasy;

sentences.zh: 且稷寬弛無防，僚吏頗侵漁之。

translations.literal: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often encroached and fleeced.
translations.idiomatic: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often preyed on the province.

sentences.zh: 州人徐道角等夜襲州城，害稷，時年六十三。

translations.literal: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others night-attacked the provincial seat and killed Ji; he was sixty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others attacked the seat by night and killed Ji, aged sixty-three.

sentences.zh: 有司奏削爵土。

translations.literal: The responsible office memorialized to strip his enfeoffment and lands.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible office memorialized to strip his fief and lands.

sentences.zh: 稷性烈亮，善與人交。

translations.literal: Ji's nature was fierce and bright, and he was good at making friends.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was fierce and bright, and good at friendship.

sentences.zh: 歷官無蓄聚，俸祿皆頒之親故，家無餘財。

translations.literal: In office he never accumulated wealth; his salary he always distributed to kin and friends, and his house had no surplus.
translations.idiomatic: He never hoarded in office; he gave his salary to kin and friends, and his house held no surplus.

sentences.zh: 初去吳興郡，以僕射徵，道由吳鄉，候稷者滿水陸。

translations.literal: When he first left Wuxing commandery and was summoned as Vice Director, his route passed his Wu homeland; those waiting to see Ji filled the waterways and roads.
translations.idiomatic: When he first left Wuxing and was summoned as vice director, his route passed Wu country; those waiting for Ji filled land and water.

sentences.zh: 稷單裝徑還京師，人莫之識，其率素如此。

translations.literal: Ji returned to the capital alone with simple baggage; no one recognized him—such was his plain simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: Ji returned to the capital alone with plain baggage; no one knew him—such was his austerity.

sentences.zh: 稷長女楚瑗，適會稽孔氏，無子歸宗。

translations.literal: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married into the Kong clan of Kuaiji; having no son, she returned to her clan.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married the Kong clan of Kuaiji; childless, she returned to her clan.

sentences.zh: 至稷見害，女以身蔽刃，先父卒。

translations.literal: When Ji was killed, his daughter used her body to shield the blade and died before her father.
translations.idiomatic: When Ji was killed, his daughter shielded him with her body and died before her father.

sentences.zh: 稷子嵊，別有傳。

translations.literal: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 卷字令遠，稷從兄也。

translations.literal: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.
translations.idiomatic: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.

sentences.zh: 少以知理著稱，能清言，仕至都官尚書，天監初卒。

translations.literal: In youth he was famed for grasping principle, could hold pure talk, and reached Capital Crimes Director in office; he died early in the Tianjian era.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was famed for grasping principle and pure talk; he reached director of capital crimes and died early in Tianjian.

sentences.zh: 王瑩字奉光，琅邪臨沂人也。

translations.literal: Wang Ying, styled Fengguang, was a native of Linyi in Langye.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ying, styled Fengguang, came from Linyi in Langye.

sentences.zh: 父懋，光祿大夫、南鄉僖侯。

translations.literal: His father Mao was Minister of the Imperial Stud and Marquis of Xiang of Nanxiang.
translations.idiomatic: His father Mao was Minister of the Imperial Stud and Marquis of Xiang of Nanxiang.

sentences.zh: 瑩選尚宋臨淮公主，拜駙馬都尉，除著作佐郎，累遷太子舍人，撫軍功曹，散騎侍郎，司徒左西屬。

translations.literal: Ying was chosen to marry the Princess of Linhuai of Song, was made Commandant of the Horse Guards, removed as Aide in the Masters of Writing, and rose through offices to Crown Prince Attendant, Pacification Army Staff Officer, and Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, then Left Western Aide of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was chosen to marry Song's Princess of Linhuai, became commandant of the horse guards, left the Masters of Writing aide post, and rose to crown prince attendant, pacification army staff officer, cavalier attendant, and left western aide of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 齊高帝爲驃騎將軍，引爲從事中郎。

translations.literal: When Qi Gaodi was Rapid Cavalry General, he brought Ying in as participation officer.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi Gaodi was Rapid Cavalry General, he brought Ying in as participation officer.

sentences.zh: 頃之，出爲義興太守，代謝超宗。

translations.literal: Shortly after, he went out as Yixing Administrator, replacing Xie Chaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he went out as Yixing administrator, replacing Xie Chaozong.

sentences.zh: 超宗去郡，與瑩交惡，旣還，間瑩於懋。

translations.literal: When Chaozong left the commandery he and Ying had become enemies; once back in the capital he slandered Ying to Mao.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozong left the commandery on bad terms with Ying; back in the capital he slandered Ying to Mao.

sentences.zh: 懋言之於朝廷，以瑩供養不足，坐失郡廢棄。

translations.literal: Mao spoke of it at court; because Ying's support of his post was insufficient, he was dismissed from his commandery and cast aside.
translations.idiomatic: Mao raised it at court; Ying's upkeep of office was judged insufficient, and he lost his commandery and was cast aside.

sentences.zh: 久之，爲前軍諮議參軍，中書侍郎，大司馬從事中郎，未拜，丁母憂。

translations.literal: After a long while he was made Front Army Advisory Staff Officer, Secretariat Gentleman, Grand Marshal Participation Officer—before he could take up the post he entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Long after, he became front army advisory staff officer, secretariat gentleman, and grand marshal participation officer; before taking post he mourned his mother.

sentences.zh: 服闋，爲給事黃門郎，出爲宣城太守，遷爲驃騎長史。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was made Yellow Gate Attendant, went out as Xuancheng Administrator, and was transferred to Rapid Cavalry Chief Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning he became yellow gate attendant, went out as Xuancheng administrator, then rapid cavalry chief clerk.

sentences.zh: 復爲黃門侍郎、司馬、太子中庶子，仍遷侍中，父憂去職。

translations.literal: He was again made Yellow Gate Attendant and Secretariat Marshal, then Crown Prince Junior Tutor, and soon transferred to Attendant Within; he left office on his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He again became yellow gate attendant and secretariat marshal, then crown prince junior tutor, soon attendant within; he left office for his father's mourning.

sentences.zh: 服闋，復爲侍中，領射聲校尉，又爲冠軍將軍、東陽太守。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was again made Attendant Within with concurrent Colonel of the Archers' Guard, then Champion General and Dongyang Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning he again became attendant within and colonel of the archers' guard, then champion general and Dongyang administrator.

sentences.zh: 居郡有惠政，遷吳興太守。

translations.literal: In the commandery he had benevolent government and was transferred to Wuxing Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In office he ruled with benevolence and was transferred to Wuxing administrator.

sentences.zh: 明帝勤憂庶政，瑩頻處二郡，皆有能名。

translations.literal: Mingdi labored anxiously over common government; Ying twice held commanderies and in both had a name for ability.
translations.idiomatic: Mingdi toiled over common government; Ying twice held commanderies and in both won a name for ability.

sentences.zh: 甚見褒美。

translations.literal: He was greatly praised.
translations.idiomatic: He was greatly praised.

sentences.zh: 還爲太子詹事、中領軍。

translations.literal: On his return he was made Crown Prince Grand Tutor and Central Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On return he became crown prince grand tutor and central army commander.

sentences.zh: 永元初，政由羣小，瑩守職而不能有所是非。

translations.literal: At the start of Yongyuan, government lay with petty men; Ying kept his post but could not judge right and wrong.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Yongyuan petty men held power; Ying kept his post but could not speak on right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 瑩從弟亮旣當朝，於瑩素雖不善，時欲引與同事。

translations.literal: Ying's cousin Liang was then in power; though he had never been close to Ying, he now wished to draw him into shared office.
translations.idiomatic: Cousin Liang was then in power; though never close to Ying, he now wished to draw him into shared office.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書左僕射，未拜。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing but did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to left vice director but did not take up the post.

sentences.zh: 會護軍崔慧景自京口奉江夏王入伐，瑩假節，率衆拒慧景於湖頭，夜爲慧景所襲，衆散，瑩赴水，乘榜入樂遊，因得還臺城。

translations.literal: When Protector General Cui Huijing raised the Prince of Jiangxia from Jingkou in revolt, Ying was granted temporary credentials, led troops to resist Huijing at Hutou, was night-attacked by Huijing, his host scattered, and Ying threw himself into the water and entered Le You on a raft, thereby returning to the terrace city.
translations.idiomatic: When Protector General Cui Huijing raised the Prince of Jiangxia from Jingkou, Ying held temporary credentials, led troops to resist Huijing at Hutou, was night-attacked, his host scattered, threw himself into the water, rafted into Le You, and so returned to the terrace city.

sentences.zh: 慧景敗，還居領軍府。

translations.literal: When Huijing was defeated, Ying returned to the Defender-in-Chief's residence.
translations.idiomatic: When Huijing was defeated, Ying returned to the defender-in-chief's residence.

sentences.zh: 義師至，復假節，都督宮城諸軍事。

translations.literal: When the Righteous Army arrived, he was again granted temporary credentials and made Area Commander of all palace-city military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous army came, he again held temporary credentials and commanded palace-city forces.

sentences.zh: 建康平，高祖爲相國，引瑩爲左長史，加冠軍將軍，奉法駕迎和帝于江陵。

translations.literal: When Jiankang was pacified, Gaozu as Chancellor of State brought Ying in as Left Chief Clerk, advanced him to Champion General, and had him escort the imperial carriage to welcome Emperor He from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiankang was pacified, Gaozu as chancellor of state brought Ying in as left chief clerk, advanced him to champion general, and had him escort the imperial carriage to welcome Emperor He from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 帝至南州，遜位于別宮。

translations.literal: When the Emperor reached Southern Province, he abdicated at a separate palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor reached Southern Province, he abdicated at a separate palace.

sentences.zh: 高祖踐阼，遷侍中、撫軍將軍，封建城縣公，邑千戶。

translations.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, Ying was transferred to Attendant Within and Pacification Army General, enfeoffed as Duke of Jiancheng with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, Ying became attendant within and pacification army general, enfeoffed as Duke of Jiancheng with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 尋遷尚書左僕射，侍中、撫軍如故。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, his attendant within and pacification army titles remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became left vice director, keeping attendant within and pacification army titles.

sentences.zh: 頃之，爲護軍將軍，復遷散騎常侍、中軍將軍、丹陽尹。

translations.literal: Shortly after, he was made Protector General, then transferred to Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Central Army General, and Danyang Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became protector general, then cavalier attendant, central army general, and Danyang intendant.

sentences.zh: 視事三年，遷侍中、光祿大夫，領左衛將軍。

translations.literal: After three years in office he was transferred to Attendant Within and Minister of the Household for the Imperial Clan, with concurrent Left Palace Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: After three years in office he became attendant within and minister of the imperial clan, with concurrent left palace guard general.

sentences.zh: 俄遷尚書令、雲麾將軍，侍中如故。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Director of the Masters of Writing and Cloud-Banner General, his attendant within title remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became director of the Masters of Writing and Cloud-Banner general, keeping attendant within.

sentences.zh: 累進號左中權將軍，給鼓吹一部。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly advanced in title to Left Central Authority General and granted one set of martial pipes and drums.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly advanced to Left Central Authority general and granted one set of pipes and drums.

sentences.zh: 瑩性清慎，居官恭恪，高祖深重之。

translations.literal: Ying's nature was pure and cautious; in office he was respectful and earnest, and Gaozu valued him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was pure and cautious; in office he was respectful and earnest, and Gaozu valued him deeply.

sentences.zh: 天監十五年，遷左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，丹陽尹、侍中如故。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Tianjian he was transferred to Left Minister of the Household for the Imperial Clan, open office with third-rank ceremonial parity, his Danyang intendant and attendant within titles remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjian year fifteen he became left minister of the imperial clan with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, keeping Danyang intendant and attendant within.

sentences.zh: 瑩將拜，印工鑄其印，六鑄而龜六毀，旣成，頸空不實，補而用之。

translations.literal: When Ying was about to take his appointment, the seal craftsmen cast his seal; six castings and six times the tortoise was ruined; once finished, the neck was hollow and not solid, yet they patched it and used it.
translations.idiomatic: When Ying was about to take office, seal craftsmen cast his seal; six castings ruined six tortoises; when finished the neck was hollow, yet they patched it and used it.

sentences.zh: 居職六日，暴疾卒。

translations.literal: After six days in office he died suddenly of illness.
translations.idiomatic: After six days in office he died suddenly.

sentences.zh: 贈侍中、左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Attendant Within, Left Minister of the Household for the Imperial Clan, and open office with third-rank ceremonial parity.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made attendant within, left minister of the imperial clan, and open office with third-rank ceremonial parity.

sentences.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：孔子稱「殷有三仁：微子去之，箕子爲之奴，比干諫而死。

translations.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Confucius said, "Yin had three worthies: Weizi left it; Jizi became its slave; Bigan remonstrated and died."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Confucius said, "Yin had three worthies: Weizi left; Jizi became a slave; Bigan remonstrated and died."

sentences.zh: 」王亮之居亂世，勢位見矣。

translations.literal: Wang Liang's standing in a chaotic age—his rank and position were plain to see.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Liang's standing in chaotic times—rank and position were plain to see.

sentences.zh: 其于取捨，何與三仁之異歟？

translations.literal: In what he took and rejected, how did he differ from the three worthies?
translations.idiomatic: In what he took and rejected, how did he differ from the three worthies?

sentences.zh: 及奉興王，蒙寬政，爲佐命，固將愧於心。

translations.literal: Yet when he served the Rising King, he received lenient policy and helped found the dynasty—he must surely have felt shame at heart.
translations.idiomatic: Yet serving the Rising King under lenient rule and helping found the dynasty, he must have felt shame at heart.

sentences.zh: 乃自取廢敗，非不幸也。

translations.literal: Then he brought ruin on himself—not misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Then he brought ruin on himself—not misfortune.

sentences.zh: 《易》曰：「非所據而據之，身必危。

translations.literal: The Changes says: "When one occupies what is not one's to occupy, the body must be in peril."
translations.idiomatic: The Changes says, "Occupy what is not yours to occupy, and the body must be in peril."

sentences.zh: 」亮之進退，失所據矣。

translations.literal: In advance and retreat, Liang lost what he should have stood on.
translations.idiomatic: In advance and retreat, Liang lost what he should have stood on.

sentences.zh: 惜哉！

translations.literal: Pity!
translations.idiomatic: Pity!

sentences.zh: 張稷因機制變，亦其時也。

translations.literal: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.

sentences.zh: 王瑩印章六毀，豈神之害盈乎？

translations.literal: Wang Ying's seal was cast six times and six times the tortoise was ruined—was it a spirit punishing fullness?
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ying's seal was cast six times and six times the tortoise was ruined—did a spirit punish excess?

translations.idiomatic: The full text was collated against the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Liang (May 1973).
